rows.requirement: Generator set continuous standby capacity shall meet the scheduled rating of 2000 kW and 2500 kVA at 0.8 PF.
Generator set output shall be 480Y/277 V, 3-phase, 4-wire, 60 Hz power.
Motor starting capability shall be not less than 3000 kVA with a maximum voltage dip of 30% for 2000 kW sets.
Excitation power to the automatic voltage regulator shall be provided by a permanent magnet generator (PMG) or equal.
Engine shall be an 8, 12, or 16 cylinder, 4-cycle diesel engine, either turbocharged/aftercooled or normally aspirated.
Governor shall be electronic speed-sensing capable of isochronous frequency regulation from no load to full rated load.
Starting system shall be 24 volt, 2-wire, negative ground, gear engaging electric starter.
Average fuel consumption at full standby load must not exceed 145 gph for a 2000 kW set.
Unit-mounted radiator cooling system sized to maintain safe operation at 122°F maximum ambient temperature.
Engine emissions compliance with applicable EPA Tier levels for non-road engines.
Operate at ambient conditions of 300 ft altitude and 10 to 122°F ambient temperature.
Engine speed shall not exceed 1800 rpm.
Generator shall be 4-pole, brushless, and two-thirds pitch wound.
Generator insulation shall be NEMA Class F or better.
Provide a 120 V, single-phase space heater to prevent condensation in the generator.
Provide 3-pole generator output circuit breaker(s) with solid-state trip units.
Maintain voltage regulation within plus 2% from no load to rated load.
Total harmonic distortion of ac voltage waveform from no load to full linear load shall not exceed 5% of rated voltage.
Provide a UL 2085 listed in-skid fuel tank with usable capacity for at least 24 hours of operation at full standby load.
Provide two 5000 W, 480 V, 1-phase jacket-water heaters.
Provide a weatherproof and rodent-proof outdoor enclosure entirely enclosing the generator set, with silencers installed inside.

follow_ups.subject: Project Alpha GEN-A - submittal review comments (19 items)
follow_ups.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your submittal (cat-3516c-2000ekw-lehe1376) against the project specification. Please respond to each item below.

1. Generator set output shall be 480Y/277 V, 3-phase, 4-wire, 60 Hz power. (spec 2.1.C (System Capacity))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.3, 2.1.C (System Capacity): "while generating 480Y/277 volt, 3-phase, 4-wire, 60 Hz power, and with performance as specified herein."
   Your submittal: cat-3516c-2000ekw-lehe1376 p.3: "Frequency 60 Hz"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

2. Motor starting capability shall be not less than 3000 kVA with a maximum voltage dip of 30% for 2000 kW sets. (spec 2.1.C.1)
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.3, 2.1.C.1: "shall be capable of developing not less than 3000 kVA (2000 kW sets) and 1500 kVA (1000 kW sets) for motor starting with a maximum voltage dip of 30%"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

3. Excitation power to the automatic voltage regulator shall be provided by a permanent magnet generator (PMG) or equal. (spec 2.1.C.2)
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.4, 2.1.C.2: "A permanent magnet generator (PMG) or equal shall provide excitation power to the automatic voltage regulator"
   Your submittal: cat-3516c-2000ekw-lehe1376 p.2: "Permanent magnet (PM)"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

4. Engine shall be an 8, 12, or 16 cylinder, 4-cycle diesel engine, either turbocharged/aftercooled or normally aspirated. (spec 2.1.D (Diesel Engine))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.4, 2.1.D (Diesel Engine): "Engine shall be an 8, 12, or 16 cylinder, 4 cycle, turbocharged/aftercooled or normally aspirated fuel injected full diesel engine"
   Your submittal: cat-3516c-2000ekw-lehe1376 p.1: "Aspiration TA"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

5. Governor shall be electronic speed-sensing capable of isochronous frequency regulation from no load to full rated load. (spec 2.1.D.3 (Governor))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.4, 2.1.D.3 (Governor): "electronic speed-sensing governor capable of isochronous frequency regulation from no load to full rated load."
   Your submittal: cat-3516c-2000ekw-lehe1376 p.1: "Governor Type A6E4"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

6. Starting system shall be 24 volt, 2-wire, negative ground, gear engaging electric starter. (spec 2.1.D.5 (Starting System))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.4, 2.1.D.5 (Starting System): "Starting System: Remote 24 volt, 2-wire, negative ground, starting system, positive shift, gear engaging electric starter"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

7. Average fuel consumption at full standby load must not exceed 145 gph for a 2000 kW set. (spec 2.1.D.1 (Diesel Fuel System))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.4, 2.1.D.1 (Diesel Fuel System): "Average fuel consumption at full standby load shall not exceed 145 gph for 2000 kW sets"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

8. Unit-mounted radiator cooling system sized to maintain safe operation at 122°F maximum ambient temperature. (spec 2.1.D.2 (Cooling System))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.4, 2.1.D.2 (Cooling System): "cooling system shall be unit mounted radiator cooled"
   Your submittal: cat-3516c-2000ekw-lehe1376 p.1: "temperatures up to 50°C (122°F)"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

9. Operate at ambient conditions of 300 ft altitude and 10 to 122°F ambient temperature. (spec 2.1.E.1)
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.4, 2.1.E.1: "Ambient conditions of 300' altitude and an ambient temperature of 10 to 122°F."
   Your submittal: cat-3516c-2000ekw-lehe1376 p.1: "temperatures up to 50°C (122°F)"
   Request: We could not find this in the submittal. Please provide the data sheet section or a written confirmation.

10. Engine speed shall not exceed 1800 rpm. (spec 2.1.E.3)
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.4, 2.1.E.3: "rpm of the engine shall not exceed 1800 rpm"
   Request: We could not find this in the submittal. Please provide the data sheet section or a written confirmation.

11. Generator shall be 4-pole, brushless, and two-thirds pitch wound. (spec 2.1.G (Generator))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.5, 2.1.G (Generator): "Generator shall be 4-pole, revolving field type, brushless, dynamically balanced, skewed laminated, two thirds pitch wound"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

12. Generator insulation shall be NEMA Class F or better. (spec 2.1.G.1)
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.5, 2.1.G.1: "NEMA Class F or better insulation as defined by NEMA MG1.65."
   Request: We could not find this in the submittal. Please provide the data sheet section or a written confirmation.

13. Provide a 120 V, single-phase space heater to prevent condensation in the generator. (spec 2.1.G.5)
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.5, 2.1.G.5: "A 120 volt, single phase space heater shall be provided to prevent condensation in the generator."
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

14. Provide 3-pole generator output circuit breaker(s) with solid-state trip units. (spec 2.1.H (Generator Output Circuit Breaker(s)))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.5, 2.1.H (Generator Output Circuit Breaker(s)): "Generator set shall have 3 pole output circuit breaker(s) with solid state trip units as shown on the drawings."
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

15. Maintain voltage regulation within plus 2% from no load to rated load. (spec 2.1.I.2 (Voltage Regulation))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.6, 2.1.I.2 (Voltage Regulation): "Voltage Regulation: Plus 2% no load to rated load; rheostat for _5% voltage adjustment."
   Request: We could not find this in the submittal. Please provide the data sheet section or a written confirmation.

16. Total harmonic distortion of ac voltage waveform from no load to full linear load shall not exceed 5% of rated voltage. (spec 2.1.I.4 (Total Harmonic Distortion (THD)))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.6, 2.1.I.4 (Total Harmonic Distortion (THD)): "The sum of ac voltage waveform harmonies, from no load to full linear load shall not exceed 5% of the rated voltage"
   Request: We could not find this in the submittal. Please provide the data sheet section or a written confirmation.

17. Provide a UL 2085 listed in-skid fuel tank with usable capacity for at least 24 hours of operation at full standby load. (spec 2.1.K.1 (In Skid Diesel Fuel Tank))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.9, 2.1.K.1 (In Skid Diesel Fuel Tank): "provided with a UL 2085 listed manufacturer's standard in skid fuel transfer day tank. The tank shall have usable capacity for not less than 24 hours of operati"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

18. Provide two 5000 W, 480 V, 1-phase jacket-water heaters. (spec 2.1.K.2 (Jacket-Water Heater))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.8, 2.1.K.2 (Jacket-Water Heater): "engine shall have two KIM #Hotstart (480 volt, 1-phase) or approved equal, 5000W jacket-water heaters supplied from a "normal" branch circuit."
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

19. Provide a weatherproof and rodent-proof outdoor enclosure entirely enclosing the generator set, with silencers installed inside. (spec 2.1.K.9 (Generator Outdoor Housing))
   Specification: 26-32-13-engine-generators-alpha p.10, 2.1.K.9 (Generator Outdoor Housing): "Provide a weatherproof and rodent-proof outdoor shelter to entirely enclose each generator set, including batteries. Silencers shall be installed inside enclosu"
   Request: We could not find this in the submittal. Please provide the data sheet section or a written confirmation.

Thank you.
Procurement, Project Alpha
